title: personal-llm-experiment-tracker-noah-2026.json
content:
Personal mini-sheet for quick experiment tracking and notes. Informal, meant as a scratchpad.

Columns: date, exp_id, model, quant, batch_size, seq_len, prompt_template, latency_ms, tokens_generated, cost_estimate_usd, notes, status

CSV table (most recent first):
2026-02-02, exp-2026-07, llama2-13b, q4_0, 8, 512, instruction-v1 (few-shot), 145, 420, 0.032, few hallucinations on list items; try prefix constraint, in_progress
2026-01-28, exp-2026-05, mixtral-8x, fp16, 4, 1024, summarization-short, 220, 980, 0.086, good summary concision, lower factuality in rare cases, done
2026-01-20, exp-2026-01, redwood-open-7b, int8, 16, 256, chat-default, 78, 210, 0.011, baseline for latency/cost, baseline
2026-01-15, exp-2026-00, redwood-open-7b, q4_0, 32, 128, chat-default, 65, 120, 0.009, aggressive batching, watch tail-latency, draft

Quick notes / TODOs:
- Add a column for "eval_prompt_set_v" to tie quality regressions to prompt suites.
- Track caching hit-rate per exp (manual for now: approx values in notes).
- Compare q4_0 vs int8 on hallucination rate for instruction-v1 prompt.
- Automate cost_estimate calculation from tokens and price table (price table in linked confluence).

Commands / snippets used:
- latency measurement: curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.dev/v1/generate -d @payload.json | jq '.metrics.latency_ms'
- local profiling: python perf/run_profile.py --model redwood-open-7b --batch 16 --seq 128

Observations:
- Increasing batch_size from 8->16 reduces per-token cost by ~12% but increases p95 by ~25ms for seq_len=256. Worth for background jobs, not for interactive chat.
- q4_0 gives ~2.3x throughput vs fp16 on my local infra measured at 512 seq, but introduces subtle token-level artifacts on numeric lists. Add explicit post-processing rules.

Scratch prompts used for eval (short):
- "Summarize the following meeting notes into 3 bullets, keep action items explicit."
- "Extract all company names and dates mentioned in the text and list as CSV."

Notes to self:
- Share exp-2026-07 results with Maya and ask for a quick eval on hallucinations (2 examples).
- If we keep q4_0 for production, add automated regression alerts tied to eval_prompt_set_v1.

References:
- PR with model config changes: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/482
- Confluence: CONFLUENCE-12345 (inference quantization notes)
- Linear task: LINEAR-9876

End of mini-sheet (lightweight, will be consolidated into team tracker once validated).
